scope: Completed real-data runs, not synthetic fixtures. Aggregate curves, counts and diagnostics; no individual tumor records or identifiers.
matrix_convention: Rows are true classes; columns are predicted classes, both in class_order.
development_definition: Pooled out-of-fold predictions from five development folds, not in-sample training predictions.

source_audit.sample_missing_meaning: Literal NA treated as missing; biological meaning remains unverified.
source_audit.sample_refit_stopping: All six stopped on plateau, not convergence.

experiments.limitation: Tumors recur across row partitions. This does not measure generalization to unseen tumors.

experiments.description: Full sample matrix, imputation, L2 logistic regression
Full sample matrix, imputation, neural network
Full sample matrix, imputation, 10-dimensional classical MDS, neural network

limitations: Matching tumor identifiers do not establish identical underlying mutation records between the two source files.
The final tumor test set has only eight lung adenocarcinomas and fourteen melanomas.
No external cohort or verified patient-level independence was established.
No identified biological signature, causal mechanism, or treatment benefit is claimed.
